policy: Only evidence-backed announcements whose target milestone occurs after the cutoff are admitted. Announcement date may precede the cutoff. These are not treated as completed history until independently confirmed.

records.title: Stargate Norway targets 100,000 NVIDIA GPUs
records.summary: Stargate Norway is planned to deliver 230MW of capacity and targets delivery of 100,000 NVIDIA GPUs by the end of 2026, with an ambition to expand further.

records.title: EU AI Gigafactory projects scheduled for selection
records.summary: EuroHPC's 2026 call states that selected AI Gigafactory projects are expected to be chosen in early 2027. The programme can establish up to seven large AI compute facilities, with operations expected within 18 months of selection.

records.title: GENIAC-PRIZE 2026 final contest and awards
records.summary: Japan's METI and NEDO scheduled the GENIAC-PRIZE 2026 final contest and awards ceremony for March 2027, with prize-money awarding scheduled for May 2027. The programme targets AI social implementation and human-resource development.

records.title: Anthropic next-generation TPU capacity starts coming online
records.summary: Anthropic announced an agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity expected to come online starting in 2027 to support frontier Claude models.

records.title: Blackstone-Google TPU cloud targets 500MW online
records.summary: Blackstone announced a joint venture with Google for a new TPU cloud, with an initial $5 billion equity commitment and an expected 500MW of capacity to come online in 2027. Google will supply TPUs, software and services.

records.title: Meta El Paso 1GW AI data-center capacity begins coming online
records.summary: Meta and BlackRock announced a 1GW data-center campus in El Paso intended to support AI models and other workloads. The venture expects to begin bringing the capacity online in 2028.

records.title: Philippines AI infrastructure first phase targets about 400MW
records.summary: The Philippines AI+ Infrastructure Masterplan 2026-2033 sets an initial deployment target of roughly 400MW of AI data-center capacity by 2030.

records.title: Philippines AI data-center capacity target reaches 1.5GW
records.summary: The Philippines AI+ Infrastructure Masterplan 2026-2033 targets expansion of AI data-center capacity from a 50MW baseline to 1.5GW by 2033.
